_about: Road trip: a journey where the group decides which stops and promises matter most. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

destination: a beach where a family is holding its last annual picnic
a mountaintop hall about to host its final dance
a coastal workshop waiting for a donated instrument
a conservatory opening a box of letters from former students
a ferry quay where a friend will leave for a year
a hilltop post office announcing which unclaimed parcels can be collected
a community garden planting a bed for people who moved away
a neighborhood theater showing home films sent in by former residents
travel_group: former classmates reusing a route planned in their final school week
siblings taking turns carrying a box promised to relatives
traveling performers who booked one final shared engagement
neighbors trading navigation and company for a seat
a parent and grown children following a hand-annotated map
co-workers using accumulated leave for a long-postponed visit
old housemates delivering belongings they left in storage
volunteers keeping a delivery route going for a friend on leave
first_stop: an orchard cafe that serves fruit from whichever tree is ripe
a repair shop with a scrapbook of names left by past travelers
an overnight ferry with a cabin that used to be a clinic
a cold hillside shelter whose keeper is about to make soup
a roadside shrine where visitors leave directions for strangers
a covered market where porters sleep between weekday shifts
a stadium car park repurposed as an early-morning flower market
a village laundromat ringing a bell when a new customer comes in
detour: a marker for a town one traveler recognizes under a different name
a plant nursery giving away its last seedlings before closing
a slow ferry whose crew invites travelers to eat with them
a village dance advertised on the back of a bus timetable
a hill path open for one day while the flowers bloom
a field recording booth a traveler wants to leave a message in
a shared meal whose host turns out to know part of your route by heart
a tiny museum asking for help matching faces to an old group photograph
travel_disagreement: someone promised a rider a seat another traveler meant to keep free
one traveler has asked a host to join them without telling the group
half the group wants to make good time and half is retracing old stops
the person keeping the schedule has an appointment they are afraid to mention
two travelers remember the reason for the original journey differently
one traveler has been paying for the others and now needs to ask for help
someone wants to document the journey and a companion wants parts kept private
a familiar route passes a home one traveler has avoided since moving away
keepsake: a tin of homemade sweets with a note tucked under the liner
a torn postcard with room left for one more address
a hand-drawn map with the food stops marked first
a wool blanket passed to whoever has the coldest seat
an envelope of pictures printed for people along the route
a paper ticket a parent once used as a bookmark
a book of recipes with a blank page for each traveler
a chipped cup a friend asked to have returned in person

1: the trip starts with a seat dispute over who gets to sit together
a host learns the destination and asks the party to carry a small message
a wrong turn brings the travelers to a place one of them recognizes
the first stop prompts two incompatible accounts of a shared memory
2: a detour worth taking uses the time promised to somebody else
a new passenger needs help across the next leg and space is tight
a companion who has been going along quietly asks to change the itinerary
a host offers to solve a travel problem if the party stays for an important event
3: the last connection and a commitment at an earlier stop now fall at the same hour
a companion considers leaving early unless the group addresses why they came
a borrowed ride ends one leg early and everyone must choose how to continue
the recipient changes their plans and the group has to decide whether to reroute
4: the destination is in sight and reaching it together means letting one traveler change the promise
only one of two important meetings is still possible and the excluded person is waiting for a call
a person at the destination asks the group to choose who keeps a responsibility created along the way
the group reaches its planned last stop and must decide whether to accompany somebody on a journey beyond it

cliches: every local exists to dispense advice to the travelers
the vehicle breaks down at every meaningful stop
the quiet traveler has been hiding a terminal diagnosis
